description: An app that brings language models directly to your phone.

summary.one_liner: PocketPal AI is an open-source React Native app that runs language models, text-to-speech, and tool use entirely on a phone, with no account or internet needed.
summary.what_it_does: The app runs GGUF language models (such as Gemma, Qwen, Phi, and Llama) fully on-device through llama.cpp, with chat history stored locally. It offers on-device text-to-speech using Kokoro and other engines via ONNX Runtime. Users can create "Pals" (Assistant or Roleplay personas) with their own model and system prompt, and browse community Pals in PalsHub. Capable models can call built-in Talents (tools) such as a calculator, date/time, and HTML rendering inside a tool-use loop. The app can search and download GGUF models from Hugging Face, including gated ones with an access token, and includes a benchmark page that measures tokens/sec and memory.
use_cases: Private offline AI chat on a phone
Running local LLMs without cloud servers
Creating custom assistant or roleplay personas
Downloading GGUF models from Hugging Face to a phone
how_to_run: yarn ios # build + run on iOS simulator
yarn android # build + run on Android emulator
notable: Fully on-device inference: conversations and documents are stated to never leave the phone
Hardware acceleration paths for CPU, GPU (Metal on iOS, OpenCL on Adreno), and NPU (Qualcomm Hexagon) with fallback
Talents tool-use framework with a TalentRegistry that developers can extend
Hugging Face integration for searching and downloading GGUF models, including gated ones
Localized in 11 languages with iPad support
caveats: Building from source requires Xcode 26.6+ with the Metal Toolchain, an Apple silicon Mac for the iOS simulator build, and Android Studio with SDK/NDK
PalsHub includes premium Pals sold via in-app purchase
PalsHub and auth features need additional configuration; core chat needs no backend keys
keywords: gemma qwen phi llama on phone
